subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should OpenClaw change the implicit elevated session default from `on` to `off`, and should `/elevated ask` remain a host-with-approval alias or become sandbox-by-default per-call opt-in elevation?
rationale: The source-reproducible behavior crosses the sandbox boundary, but the current docs intentionally define `/elevated ask` as `on` and changing defaults may affect existing trusted-operator workflows.

options.title: Fix default, preserve ask
options.body: Change the missing elevated default to `off`, add regression tests/docs, and leave `/elevated ask` as host-with-approvals unless a separate product decision changes it.

options.title: Redefine ask too
options.body: Change both the implicit default and `/elevated ask` into a per-call-only elevation model, with docs, system prompt, and upgrade communication updated together.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Treat `tools.elevated.enabled` as an explicit opt-in to session-level host exec by default and close the issue only after clarifying any docs that imply otherwise.

recommendation.title: Fix default, preserve ask
recommendation.body: Change the missing elevated default to `off`, add regression tests/docs, and leave `/elevated ask` as host-with-approvals unless a separate product decision changes it.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection to elevated ask/full semantics and exec target routing.
